input: Good morning, I hope this message finds you well. I understand that policies can sometimes be complex, but I was under the impression that purchasing these three specific items together would automatically trigger the 15% reduction. Could you please review my order details and let me know if there is any way to correct this? I would greatly appreciate your assistance in resolving this matter, as I value your customer service and hope to continue supporting your business. Thank you for your time and consideration.
